sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.182 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B, 302 IPC & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Tarun, District Faizabad/Ayodhya.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 18.05.2022 and sufficient dowry was also given, however, the matrimonial family used to make demand for additional dowry and on 04.06.2024, the son-in-law of the informant informed that the daughter has committed suicide.

The postmortem report on record indicates presence of Kashi Ram Chauraisia vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73377732/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: three injuries on the head, based upon which, the applicant is sought to be implicated under Section 302 IPC also.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant, based upon the statement of the witnesses, states that the applicant is father-in-law and was having a separate living and in terms of the statement, he was not even present on the said date.
The charge-sheet has been filed against the applicant, his brother as well as his son.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that the applicant has a separate living and there is no specific allegation against the applicant of having caused the injuries which resulted in death, the applicant who is aged about 60 years and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.
